title: Unraveling Downstream Gender Bias from Large Language Models: A Study on AI Educational Writing Assistance

bias_targets.methodology: GenBit analysis to measure co-occurrence of gendered words in student peer reviews and model suggestions; WEAT and SEAT tests (specifically tests 6, 7, and 8) applied to model embeddings and text corpora to evaluate associations between gender terms (male/female) and concepts like career, family, math, science, and arts.
